source: Immutable S3 archive snapshots via rsmbtv profile, rebuilt into fresh local staging after station-coverage fixes

provenance.hashEncoding: Sorted relative POSIX path, NUL byte, then exact JSON bytes per archive

schemas: all reconstructed dates and rolling summary passed shared/temperatureSchemas.ts

coverage.stationMetadata: All archived station UIDs present in merged catalog
coverage.historicalThresholdPresence: Every archived rh/rl retains a finite corresponding repaired mh/ml

knownLimitations.resolution: Unresolved numerical conflicts between source vintages; cause unconfirmed. Preserve raw observations and legacy rh/rl without coercion. These checks establish schema, field presence, preservation and reconstruction, not independent historical source accuracy.
knownLimitations.fallbackInterpretation: Explicit M verifies the current upstream response and does not erase older archived temperatures or independently resolve source-vintage accuracy.
knownLimitations.upstreamRevisionPolicy: No automatic refresh policy for subsequent ACIS observation corrections.
